title: Plugin State
description: Framework plugin load state tracking. Synchronized with .task_temp/_logs/index.json by state-reconciliation.

last_reconciliation.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last reconciliation between machine.json and index.json.

plugins.description: Per-plugin state tracking keyed by plugin name (e.g., session, scope-before, uc7ks-before).

loaded.description: Whether the plugin module was successfully imported.

hooks_registered.description: Whether the plugin registered at least one hook event.

last_seen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last plugin activity (load or hook trigger).
